items.title: AI晶片需求推升韓元！第三季狂升13%創近28年新高、南韓央行示警
items.title_en: AI Chip Demand Boosts Won! 13% Surge in Q3 Sets Near-28-Year High, BOK Issues Warning
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續升溫，帶動南韓半導體出口及外資資金流入，韓元今年第三季兌美元大幅升值約13%，創下1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。不過，南韓央行貨幣政策委員會成員Hwang Kunil警告，近期韓元升值速度超出預期，必須密切關注匯率波動，強勢韓元也可能對出口及中小企業造成壓力。
根據《路透》報導，Hwang指出，評估匯率時，應關注波動程度及變動速度，而非僅看匯率絕對水準。他認為，近期韓元升值步伐有些超出預期，央行正密切監測相關變化。
他也提醒，隨著龐大的經常帳順差及外資資產配置調整效應逐漸消退，韓元仍可能面臨貶值壓力。
此次示警正值南韓央行面臨貨幣政策兩難之際。央行本月在連續兩次升息後暫停升息，維持基準利率在3%，但仍保留進一步緊縮的可能性。
韓元升值雖有助降低進口成本、抑制通膨，卻也可能削弱出口競爭力，加上國內消費復甦緩慢及中小企業經營壓力升高，使政策決策更加複雜。

AI晶片需求帶動美元流入 韓元單季升幅創近28年新高

韓元第三季兌美元升值約13%，為1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。Hwang將這波升值主要歸因於全球AI基礎建設投資熱潮，帶動南韓半導體出口及美元資金流入。
隨著AI算力需求快速增加，市場對SK海力士(000660KS) 及三星電子(005930KS) 生產的專用記憶體晶片需求大增，推升南韓出口收入，也為韓元帶來支撐。
Hwang預估，南韓今年經常帳順差可能從央行8月預測的4,500億美元，增加至接近5,000億美元。
不過，他也指出，若全球AI支出放緩，經常帳順差可能減少約500億美元，將對以出口為導向的南韓經濟成長造成衝擊。
儘管如此，他認為，當前AI產業景氣繁榮可能持續更長時間。

強勢韓元衝擊出口 中小企業未能共享AI紅利

韓元升值並非所有產業都能受惠。雖然南韓大型半導體企業受益於AI晶片需求，但匯率走強也會提高南韓出口商品的外幣價格，削弱海外市場競爭力，對出口導向型企業形成壓力。
Hwang指出，出口在南韓經濟中的重要性雖已不如過去，但仍是經濟結構的重要支柱。目前出口表現強勁，卻未能帶動各產業及不同群體同步受惠，民間消費復甦依然緩慢。
他表示，經濟成長帶來的正面效益集中在特定群體，但高利率與高物價卻影響所有人，最終經濟表現將取決於兩股力量何者較強。
中小企業的經營狀況尤其令人憂慮。Hwang指出，南韓中小企業違約率持續上升，國內需求疲弱，企業經營壓力加重。
更值得注意的是，部分企業借款並非用於擴大資本投資，而是拿來支付薪資、原材料等日常營運成本，反映企業資金周轉及財務狀況面臨挑戰。
在此情況下，大型出口企業能夠受惠於AI晶片需求，中小企業卻未必能分享出口成長紅利，還得面對高利率及營運資金壓力，形成不同規模企業之間的景氣落差。

韓元升值有助壓通膨 南韓央行陷政策兩難

通膨走勢也是南韓央行關注的重點。Hwang預估，南韓整體消費者物價通膨率將於2027年上半年末開始接近央行2%的目標，並在2027年底或2028年初完全穩定於目標水準。
韓元升值有助降低進口商品價格，進而緩和通膨壓力，但也可能進一步壓縮出口企業的獲利空間。另一方面，能源價格風險及經濟韌性，仍是央行考慮進一步緊縮貨幣政策的因素。
Hwang被市場視為南韓央行貨幣政策委員會中最鴿派的成員之一，今年8月升息時曾投下反對票。此次公開提醒韓元升值過快，也凸顯南韓央行在穩定物價、維持出口競爭力及支撐國內經濟之間，面臨的政策取捨。
paras_en: Global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure continues to heat up, driving South Korea's semiconductor exports and foreign capital inflows, with the won appreciating about 13% against the dollar in the third quarter, the largest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. However, BOK Monetary Policy Committee member Hwang Kunil warned that the recent pace of won appreciation exceeds expectations and must be closely monitored, as a strong won could also pressure exports and small‑and‑medium enterprises.

According to Reuters, Hwang said that when assessing exchange rates, one should focus on volatility and the speed of change rather than just the absolute level. He believes the recent appreciation of the won has been somewhat beyond expectations, and the central bank is closely monitoring the developments.
He also cautioned that as the massive current‑account surplus and the effects of foreign‑asset allocation adjustments wane, the won could still face depreciation pressure.

This warning comes as the BOK faces a policy dilemma. After two consecutive rate hikes this month, the bank paused further hikes, keeping the policy rate at 3% while still leaving open the possibility of additional tightening.

While a stronger won helps lower import costs and curb inflation, it may also weaken export competitiveness, and combined with sluggish domestic consumption recovery and rising pressures on SMEs, policy decisions become more complex.

AI chip demand drives dollar inflows, won's quarterly rise hits near‑28‑year high. The won appreciated about 13% against the dollar in Q3, the biggest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. Hwang attributes this surge mainly to the global AI infrastructure investment boom, which has boosted South Korean semiconductor exports and dollar inflows.

As AI computing power demand surges, the market’s need for specialized memory chips produced by SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) has risen sharply, lifting South Korean export revenues and supporting the won.
Hwang estimates South Korea's current‑account surplus this year could rise from the BOK’s August forecast of $450 billion to nearly $500 billion.
However, he notes that if global AI spending slows, the current‑account surplus could shrink by about $50 billion, hitting the export‑driven Korean economy.
Nonetheless, he believes the current AI industry boom could last longer than expected.

Strong won hits exports; SMEs miss out on AI gains. The won’s appreciation does not benefit all sectors. While large Korean semiconductor firms profit from AI chip demand, a stronger currency raises the foreign‑currency price of Korean export goods, weakening overseas competitiveness and pressuring export‑oriented firms.

Hwang points out that although exports are less central to the Korean economy than before, they remain a key pillar. Export performance is strong but has not translated into benefits across all industries and groups, and consumer recovery remains slow.

He says the positive effects of economic growth are concentrated in specific groups, while high interest rates and prices affect everyone, and ultimately economic performance will depend on which force proves stronger.
The situation of SMEs is especially concerning. Hwang notes that default rates among Korean SMEs are rising, domestic demand is weak, and business pressures are intensifying.
Moreover, some firms borrow not to expand capital investment but to cover payroll, raw materials and other operating costs, reflecting challenges in cash flow and financial health.

In this context, large exporters can benefit from AI chip demand, but SMEs may not share in export growth gains and must still face high rates and working‑capital pressures, creating a disparity in fortunes between firms of different sizes.

Won appreciation helps tame inflation, putting the BOK in a policy bind. Inflation trends are also a key focus for the BOK. Hwang projects that South Korea’s overall consumer price inflation will approach the bank’s 2% target by the end of the first half of 2027 and fully stabilize at the target by the end of 2027 or early 2028.

A stronger won lowers import prices, easing inflation pressure, but may further squeeze profit margins for exporters. Meanwhile, energy price risks and economic resilience remain factors the bank considers when contemplating further monetary tightening.

Hwang is seen as one of the most dovish members of the BOK’s Monetary Policy Committee and cast a dissenting vote during the August rate hike. His public warning about the won’s rapid appreciation highlights the BOK’s trade‑off between stabilising prices, maintaining export competitiveness and supporting the domestic economy.

items.title: Alphabet黑色10月！單月市值蒸發7580億美元、創上市以來最慘表現 本益比降至十年新低
items.title_en: Alphabet's Black October! Market Cap Evaporates $758 B in a Month, Worst Performance Since IPO, P/E Hits 10‑Year Low
paras: 大型科技股經歷慘烈一周，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)成為這波跌勢的核心。根據《Yahoo Finance》計算，Alphabet本周市值蒸發4680億美元，超過SpaceX(SPCX-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)市值減少的總和。
這是Google母公司史上最慘的一周，也是美國上市公司史上第二大單周市值損失。只有輝達的單周市值蒸發幅度更大：2025年1月27日那周，中國DeepSeek震撼AI投資人，輝達市值一周減少約5520億美元。Alphabet先前最慘的一周發生在6月26日為止一周，市值減少約3860億美元。
Alphabet周四公布第3季財報後，當天市值蒸發4750億美元，是這波跌勢的主要來源。周五(30日)股價再度下滑，抹去本周稍早累積的漲幅。

10月市值蒸發7580億美元 單月跌幅近19%

周五收盤後，Alphabet的10月表現正式寫下紀錄：無論以市值損失金額或股價跌幅計算，都是該公司上市以來最慘烈的一個月。
Alphabet本月市值減少約7580億美元，是美國上市公司史上第二大單月市值損失，僅次於SpaceX今年7月市值蒸發約8220億美元的紀錄。
Alphabet本月市值損失幾乎是先前最慘月份的兩倍。該公司先前最慘的月份是2025年2月，當時市值減少約4200億美元。
若以百分比計算，Alphabet股價10月下跌近19%。先前最慘的是2008年11月，當時股價下跌18.5%。本周股價則下跌近13%，創2011年8月以來最大單周跌幅。
這波賣壓也使Alphabet本益比降至逾10年來最低水準。

不只Alphabet遭血洗 英特爾單日重挫近30%

SpaceX、英特爾(INTC-US)與輝達本周市值也各自減少逾1000億美元。
英特爾因財測疲弱，周五股價一度下跌30%，創數十年來最大跌幅。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周四公布財報後，本周市值減少約800億美元。
部分軟體股以百分比計算的跌幅更為慘重，ServiceNow(NOW-US)與Fortinet(FTNT-US)股價約下跌25%至34%。

瑞銀不建議退場 籲投資人分散科技股曝險

不過，市場蒸發的市值並非全數流出股市。禮來(LLY-US)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SK海力士(SKHY-US)本周市值合計增加逾3000億美元，即使「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent 7)整體表現疲弱，仍有部分企業逆勢成長。
瑞銀(UBS)投資長辦公室主張，投資人不應因市場波動而急著退場。
瑞銀美洲區投資長暨全球股票主管Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi周五寫道：「在我們看來，進一步的波動並不代表撤出市場就能有效保護投資組合，避免潛在的下跌風險。我們仍認為整體股市有上漲空間，並相信投資人應聚焦打造具韌性的投資組合，納入科技股以外的投資部位。」
paras_en: Large tech stocks endured a brutal week, with Alphabet (GOOGL-US) at the core of the decline. Yahoo Finance calculates that Alphabet’s market value shrank by $468 billion this week, exceeding the combined loss of SpaceX (SPCX-US), Intel (INTC-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US).

It was the worst week ever for Google’s parent company and the second‑largest single‑week market‑cap loss in U.S. listed‑company history. Only Nvidia’s weekly loss was larger: in the week of Jan. 27, 2025, Nvidia’s market cap fell about $552 billion after DeepSeek’s AI shock in China. Alphabet’s previous worst week was the week ending June 26, when its market cap dropped about $386 billion.

Alphabet released its Q3 earnings on Thursday, and that day its market cap evaporated $4.75 billion, fueling the sell‑off. On Friday (the 30th) the stock fell again, erasing the modest gains it had accumulated earlier in the week.

October market‑cap loss of $758 billion, nearly 19% drop for the month. After Friday’s close, Alphabet’s October performance officially set a record: by both market‑cap loss and share‑price decline, it was the company’s worst month since going public.
Alphabet’s market cap fell about $758 billion this month, the second‑largest single‑month loss among U.S. listed firms, trailing only SpaceX’s July loss of roughly $822 billion this year.
The monthly loss is almost twice the size of Alphabet’s previous worst month. That prior low was February 2025, when the market cap shrank about $420 billion.

In percentage terms, Alphabet’s stock fell nearly 19% in October. The worst month on record was November 2008, when the price dropped 18.5%. This week the stock fell about 13%, the biggest one‑week decline since August 2011.
The selling pressure also pushed Alphabet’s price‑to‑earnings ratio down to its lowest level in more than a decade.
Alphabet wasn’t the only victim; Intel saw a single‑day plunge of almost 30%.
SpaceX, Intel (INTC-US) and Nvidia each shed over $100 billion in market value this week.
Intel’s weak guidance sent its share price down 30% on Friday, the biggest drop in decades. Amazon (AMZN-US) posted earnings on Thursday, and its market cap fell about $80 billion this week.
Some software stocks suffered even steeper percentage declines, with ServiceNow (NOW-US) and Fortinet (FTNT-US) sliding roughly 25% to 34%.

However, not all market‑cap loss left the market. Lilly (LLY-US), Tesla (TSLA-US) and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) together added over $300 billion in market value this week, showing that even as the “Magnificent 7” lagged, some companies grew against the tide.
UBS’s investment‑strategy office argues investors should not rush to exit because of market turbulence.

items.title: 奧特曼訪南韓會三星高層！OpenAI深化記憶體合作、劍指AI資料中心與星際之門
items.title_en: Sam Altman Visits South Korea to Meet Samsung Executives! OpenAI Deepens Memory Chip Collaboration, Targets AI Data Centers and Stargate
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）週六（31日）在南韓與三星(KR005930) 高層主管會面，隨著全球記憶體晶片短缺情況日益加劇，雙方希望深化在記憶體晶片及人工智慧（AI）基礎設施方面的合作。
根據《彭博》報導，三星在聲明中表示，集團在首爾以南的龍仁市接待奧特曼，並安排他與旗下電子、金融及生技事業體約50名主管進行會談。討論重點包括AI在未來十年如何重塑各產業、企業決策方式及商業機會。
週六的會談延續雙方先前宣布的合作關係。三星將為OpenAI的「星際之門」（Stargate）基礎設施計畫供應記憶體晶片，並與OpenAI合作建置AI資料中心，合作範圍包括離岸浮動式設施。
同時，三星也正加快在旗下各事業導入AI，應用領域涵蓋研究、製造、行銷及企業營運。
這場會面正值全球記憶體市場供應緊張，多種記憶體產品短缺已對電子產業造成壓力，並推升晶片價格。
資料中心業者積極爭取供應，加劇記憶體市場競爭。據估計，AI基礎設施競賽中規模最大的五家業者，未來幾年計畫投入資金合計超過3兆美元，而記憶體約占資料中心支出的三分之一。
南韓是先進記憶體晶片的主要生產國，當地企業與消費者採用AI的速度也正加快，而奧特曼是近期造訪南韓的美國科技業領袖之一。
輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）及超微半導體執行長蘇姿丰（Lisa Su）自去年以來都曾兩度訪問南韓，以強化供應鏈合作。此外，多位科技高層先前已發出警告，表示晶片產能難以跟上市場需求。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with senior executives of Samsung (KR005930) on Saturday (31st) in South Korea, as the global shortage of memory chips worsens, with both parties aiming to deepen cooperation in memory chip and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

According to Bloomberg, Samsung stated in a press release that it hosted Altman in Yongin, south of Seoul, and arranged meetings with about 50 executives from its electronics, finance and biotechnology divisions. The discussion focused on how AI will reshape various industries, corporate decision-making, and business opportunities over the next decade.

The Saturday talks continued the partnership announced earlier. Samsung will supply memory chips for OpenAI’s Stargate infrastructure project and collaborate on building AI data centers, including offshore floating facilities.
At the same time, Samsung is accelerating AI adoption across its businesses, with applications spanning research, manufacturing, marketing and corporate operations.
The meeting comes amid tight global memory supply, with shortages of various memory products putting pressure on the electronics industry and driving up chip prices.

Data center operators are aggressively competing for supply, intensifying market competition. It is estimated that the five largest players in the AI infrastructure race plan to invest more than $3 trillion over the coming years, with memory accounting for about one-third of data center spend.
South Korea is a leading producer of advanced memory chips, and local companies and consumers are rapidly adopting AI, while Altman is one of the recent U.S. tech leaders to visit the country.

NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and semiconductor giant AMD CEO Lisa Su have each visited South Korea twice since last year to strengthen supply‑chain cooperation. Several tech leaders have previously warned that chip capacity cannot keep pace with market demand.

items.title: 砸錢拚AI不再加分？雲端大廠股價劇烈分化 市場獎勵克制、懲罰開支
items.title_en: Spending on AI No Longer a Bonus? Cloud Giants' Stocks Diverge Sharply as Market Rewards Restraint and Punishes Expenditure
paras: AI雲端大廠股價劇烈分化，市場正在獎勵克制、懲罰開支？甲骨文(ORCL-US) 10月28日收盤大漲10.73%，谷歌母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 隔日盤前卻重挫逾10%，微軟(MSFT-US) 則上漲逾4%。鮮明反差顯示，投資人不再一味追捧龐大AI投資，而是更在意支出何時見頂、現金流何時改善，以及企業還得向外籌措多少資金。
谷歌現金流惡化 微軟支出低於預期
谷歌第三財季營收與獲利均不如預期，自由現金流更連續兩季為負，顯示巨額AI投資尚未帶來足夠回報，難以證明支出的合理性。
微軟的情況則相對穩健。第一財季資本支出年增30%至452億美元，低於分析師預期；自由現金流雖年減27%，仍達186.3億美元。財報公布後，微軟10月29日盤前上漲逾4%。
兩者對比反映，市場關注的已不只是AI投入規模，也包括企業能否在擴張之際維持現金流。
甲骨文畫出時間表 股價大漲逾一成
甲骨文重新獲得市場青睞，關鍵在於提出資本支出見頂與現金流轉正的時間表。公司預估，資本支出將在2027至2028財年見頂，2029財年開始下降。
財務長Hilary Maxson表示，自由現金流預計自2028財年下半年轉正，2029財年將超過300億美元。甲骨文並預期，自2029財年起，不再需要依賴外部融資支撐成長，同期淨債務與年度核心獲利比率將降至3.5倍以下。
這番說法為高額AI投資畫出較明確的時間界線。甲骨文10月28日盤中一度上漲逾13%，收盤漲幅達10.73%。
融資壓力仍在 承諾有待兌現
不過，甲骨文的資金壓力尚未解除。相較微軟、亞馬遜與谷歌，其營收基礎較薄弱，且高度依賴單一客戶OpenAI。雙方合作帶來數千億美元的雲端待履行合約，也迫使甲骨文透過舉債與發股，籌資興建資料中心。
截至8月31日，甲骨文應付票據與其他借款合計1,253.4億美元，現金及約當現金約363.7億美元。公司在2027財年剩餘期間仍需額外籌資最多200億美元，債務與股權融資各占一半，並稱這將是完成本輪投資週期所需的最後一筆融資。
在現金流轉正前，甲骨文將透過供應商融資、客戶提供硬體或支付預付款，降低前期現金需求。
Emarketer分析師Jacob Bourne指出，甲骨文試圖證明，大規模AI投資有明確規劃。這些預測雖積極，卻不保證能實現，但至少顯示公司理解投資人的疑慮，並提出解決路徑。
AI投資回報面臨更嚴格檢驗
三家大廠的市場反應顯示，投資人正更嚴格檢視資本支出與現金流。甲骨文獲得肯定的，是提出支出降溫與減少融資依賴的路徑；谷歌則因業績不如預期、現金流惡化而承壓。
高盛首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius本週也警告，超大規模資料中心的AI投資成長預計將在未來幾週見頂。經過多年密集投入，AI投資能否轉化為現金回報，正成為市場評價雲端大廠的重要依據。
paras_en: AI cloud giants' stock prices are diverging sharply, with the market rewarding restraint and penalizing spending. Oracle (ORCL-US) surged 10.73% on October 28, Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, plunged more than 10% in pre‑market trading the next day, and Microsoft (MSFT-US) rose over 4%. The stark contrast shows investors are no longer blindly cheering massive AI spending; they care more about when expenditures will peak, when cash flow will improve, and how much external financing companies will still need.
Google's cash flow deteriorates while Microsoft’s spending comes in below expectations

Google’s third‑quarter revenue and profit both missed expectations, and free cash flow was negative for a second consecutive quarter, indicating that huge AI investments have not yet generated sufficient returns and cannot justify the outlays.

Microsoft’s situation is relatively solid. Capital expenditures in the first quarter rose 30% year‑over‑year to $45.2 billion, below analysts’ forecasts; free cash flow fell 27% year‑over‑year but still amounted to $18.63 billion. After the earnings release, Microsoft rose more than 4% in pre‑market trading on October 29.
The contrast between the two reflects that the market is now focused not only on the scale of AI investment but also on whether companies can maintain cash flow while expanding.
Oracle charts a timeline, stock jumps more than 10%

Oracle has regained market favor by laying out a timeline for capital‑expenditure peaks and a return to positive cash flow. The company projects that capex will peak in fiscal 2027‑2028 and start to decline in fiscal 2029.

Chief Financial Officer Hilary Maxson said free cash flow is expected to turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and exceed $30 billion in fiscal 2029. Oracle also expects that from fiscal 2029 onward it will no longer need external financing to support growth, and its net‑debt‑to‑core‑earnings ratio will fall below 3.5×.
This guidance draws a clearer time horizon for Oracle’s large AI investments. Oracle’s stock rose more than 13% intraday on October 28 and closed up 10.73%.
Financing pressure remains, promises yet to be fulfilled

However, Oracle’s financing pressure has not been eliminated. Compared with Microsoft, Amazon and Google, its revenue base is weaker and it is heavily dependent on a single customer, OpenAI. The partnership brings cloud contracts worth hundreds of billions of dollars that still need to be fulfilled, forcing Oracle to raise debt and issue equity to fund data‑center construction.

As of August 31, Oracle’s notes and other borrowings totaled $125.34 billion, while cash and cash equivalents were about $36.37 billion. The company says it will need up to an additional $20 billion of financing during the remainder of fiscal 2027, split evenly between debt and equity, and that this will be the final round of financing needed to complete the current investment cycle.
Before cash flow turns positive, Oracle will rely on supplier financing, hardware provided by customers, or advance payments to reduce early cash needs.

eMarketer analyst Jacob Bourne noted that Oracle is trying to prove that large‑scale AI investment can be done with a clear plan. While the forecasts are optimistic and not guaranteed to materialize, they at least show the company understands investors’ concerns and is offering a path forward.
AI investment returns face stricter scrutiny

The market reactions to the three giants show investors are scrutinizing capital spending and cash flow more rigorously. Oracle earned praise for outlining a path to cool spending and reduce financing reliance; Google is under pressure due to weaker results and deteriorating cash flow.

Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius warned this week that the growth of ultra‑large data‑center AI investments is expected to peak in the coming weeks. After years of intensive spending, whether AI investment can be turned into cash returns is becoming a key metric for evaluating cloud providers.

items.title: Google跨足川普「金穹」計畫？傳洽談資料安全合作 搶攻1850億美元商機
items.title_en: Google Moves Into Trump’s “Golden Dome” Project? Reports of Data‑Security Talks Target $185 B Opportunity
paras: 知情人士透露，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google正與美國國防部洽談，準備參與一項新的資安計畫，為規模1850億美元「金穹」(Golden Dome)的飛彈防禦計畫提供支援，是這家科技巨頭首度傳出參與美國總統川普主打的國防計畫。
知情人士表示，五角大廈正在籌組專門的產業聯盟，負責保護輸送至計畫核心軍事指揮與控制軟體的資料管道。雙方討論重點包括採用Google的資料儲存、網路連接及網路安全基礎設施，確保即使對手破壞傳統地面網路或行動通訊基地台，通訊仍能維持運作。

Google旗下Aalyria也可能參與

儘管相關討論仍處於初步階段，未來安排也可能變動，但預料將有多家商業合作夥伴參與這項計畫，包括Google分拆成立的網路技術公司Aalyria Technologies。
「金穹」是川普主打的國防計畫，目標是建立從地面延伸至太空的多層防禦系統，以保護美國免受外國攻擊。
金穹計畫的指揮與控制系統由另一個獨立聯盟負責開發，成員包括Anduril、Palantir(PLTR-US)及SpaceX(SPCX-US)。該系統旨在整合並控制美軍各地的武器系統、雷達及其他過去彼此獨立運作的軍事系統。
若洽談最終促成合作，將是Google首度傳出參與金穹計畫，也再次凸顯這家搜尋引擎巨頭正持續擴大在國安與國防領域的布局。

Google曾因軍事AI引發內部反彈 如今加深國防合作

這項計畫凸顯五角大廈正刻意轉向多家業者組成的產業聯盟，不再單靠一家傳統主要承包商管理龐大的國防系統架構。
同時，這也反映Google在多年來因國防業務引發內部摩擦後，正加速拓展國家安全相關合約。
Google參與國防業務的歷史並不平順。2018年，數千名Google員工曾抗議公司參與名為「Maven計畫」的軍事AI專案，理由是擔憂商業技術被用於戰爭，Google最終沒有續約。
然而在那之後，Alphabet有系統地擴大公共部門業務布局，成立專責政府業務的部門，並與軍方簽署提供AI及雲端運算能力的合約。
最近一次重要進展發生在今年4月，Alphabet取得一項協議，將把自家專有AI模型部署於機密國防作業，進一步深化與美國國防部的合作。
paras_en: A source familiar with the matter says Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Google is in talks with the U.S. Department of Defense to take part in a new cyber‑security effort supporting the $185 billion “Golden Dome” missile‑defense program, marking the first time the tech giant has been linked to a defense initiative championed by President Trump.

The source adds that the Pentagon is forming a dedicated industry alliance to safeguard the data pipelines that feed the program’s core command‑and‑control software. Discussions focus on using Google’s data storage, networking and cyber‑security infrastructure to keep communications alive even if adversaries disrupt traditional ground networks or mobile‑base stations.

Google’s spin‑off Aalyria Technologies may also join. Although talks are still in early stages and plans could change, several commercial partners are expected to take part, including Aalyria, a network‑technology company spun out of Google.
The “Golden Dome” is a Trump‑promoted defense initiative aimed at building a multi‑layered shield that extends from the ground into space to protect the United States from foreign attacks.

The command‑and‑control system for the Golden Dome is being developed by a separate independent consortium that includes Anduril, Palantir (PLTR‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US). The system is intended to integrate and control U.S. military weapons, radars and other previously siloed systems worldwide.

If the talks lead to a deal, it would be the first report of Google joining the Golden Dome project and underscores how the search‑engine giant is expanding its footprint in national security and defense.

The project highlights the Pentagon’s deliberate shift toward industry alliances composed of multiple firms rather than relying on a single traditional prime contractor to manage massive defense system architectures.
It also reflects Google’s accelerating push into national‑security contracts after years of internal friction over its defense work.

Google’s defense‑sector history has been rocky. In 2018, thousands of employees protested the company’s involvement in the “Maven” military AI project, fearing commercial technology would be used for warfare, and Google ultimately let the contract lapse.

Since then, Alphabet has systematically broadened its public‑sector business, creating a dedicated government‑sales unit and signing contracts to provide AI and cloud‑computing capabilities to the military.

The most recent major development came in April this year, when Alphabet secured an agreement to deploy its proprietary AI models for classified defense operations, deepening its collaboration with the U.S. Department of Defense.

items.title: 黑石：Anthropic在IPO後或只能獲得「垃圾」評級！融資成本恐攀升
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 的融資前景面臨新挑戰。全球私募股權巨頭黑石(BX-US) 已向投資人示警，Anthropic 上市後可能無法立即取得投資級信用評級，主要評級機構更可能將其評為較高級的「垃圾級」。
根據《金融時報》報導，黑石是在向 Anthropic 最新一筆630億美元晶片融資案的投資人傳達上述看法。
若 Anthropic 最終未能取得投資級評級，未來為規模超過8,000億美元的算力基礎設施計畫籌資，恐將面臨更大難度。
相關消息也加劇市場對 AI 產業投資熱潮的疑慮。週五（30日）美國科技股在報導曝光後進一步走低，那斯達克100指數終場下跌3.5%。
此前，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 公布財報，已使市場更加擔憂 AI 熱潮能否持續。

Anthropic投資級評級預期生變 融資成本恐攀升

知情人士表示，過去幾個月，黑石一直向投資夥伴表示，預期 Anthropic 能在今年底前取得投資級評級。
不過，根據主要信用評級機構提供的指引，黑石近期已調整看法，認為 Anthropic 更可能獲得 BB 級或以上。
依標普及惠譽的評等體系，BBB-以上為投資等級，BB+以下為投機級，市場俗稱「垃圾級」。 BB區間（BB+、BB、BB-）是垃圾級中最高的一檔，緊鄰投資等級門檻，也是「較高檔」垃圾等級的意義。
這項評級結果對 Anthropic 尤為重要。公司已於週一遞交上市申請，最快可能在下月完成有史以來規模最大的首次公開發行（IPO）。招股文件揭露，Anthropic 計畫從現在起至2045年，在算力基礎設施投入超過8,000億美元。
目前 Anthropic 持有超過1,120億美元現金及約當現金，市場預期 IPO 還可能為公司帶來約1,000億美元資金。
取得投資級評級，將有助 Anthropic 以較低利率借款，支應龐大的基礎設施投資。相較之下，許多保險公司與退休基金受到投資規範限制，主要只能配置投資級債券，或對垃圾級債務設有持有上限。
一旦 Anthropic 的信用評級落在 BB+或以下，可取得的機構資金來源將明顯縮減，借貸成本也可能隨之上升。
一名專注美國科技股的基金經理指出，能否取得信貸對 Anthropic 至關重要，若公司無法取得投資級評級，融資成本將會提高，對所有相關方都不是好消息。
Anthropic 與競爭對手 OpenAI 的銀行團隊，目前都正積極遊說主要信用評級機構，希望兩家公司上市後能取得投資級評級。
不過，對企業融資成本影響最大的三大評級機構惠譽、穆迪（Moody's）與標普，至今尚未正式給予 Anthropic 信用評級。

630億美元「北極星計畫」 仰賴博通信用背書

Anthropic 最新一筆630億美元融資交易代號為「北極星計畫」（Project North Star），華爾街銀行已於本週稍早完成交割，資金將用於支應 Anthropic 向Google(GOOGL-US) 租用1.5GW晶片的相關支出。
黑石在這筆交易中擔任主要投資人，並與參與融資的銀行合作，將債務轉售給其他投資者。
這筆交易的架構也凸顯 Anthropic 對供應商信用支持的依賴。其中，超過420億美元的優先級貸款由博通(AVGO-US) 提供擔保。
博通參與這批晶片的共同開發，並擁有 A 級高位的投資級信用評級，成為 Anthropic 得以取得這筆融資的重要條件。
優先級債務受到機構投資人青睞，主要原因在於一旦發生違約，優先級貸款的受償順位高於次級債務。
另外180億美元的次級債務，則以 Anthropic 的租賃付款作為償債支撐，因此貸款人承擔的 Anthropic 信用風險更為直接。
《金融時報》此前報導，黑石旗下基金以超過10%的高收益率，認購其中90億美元次級債務。
這部分次級債務獲得 Kroll Bond Rating Agency（KBRA）評定為 BB+，展望為正面，相較四個月前類似的「大天空計畫」（Big Sky），當時獲得的展望為穩定，評級展望已有改善。晨星 DBRS（Morningstar DBRS）則給予 BB 評級。
對於相關報導，Anthropic、黑石、KBRA、晨星 DBRS 與標普均拒絕置評，惠譽與穆迪則未回覆置評請求。

items.title: 科技債成「待發掘鑽石」！策略師：AI巨頭舉債之際投資人迎來機會
items.title_en: Tech Bonds Are the “Undiscovered Diamonds”! Strategist Says AI Giants’ Debt Issuances Create Opportunities for Investors
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，美銀首席策略師在AI投資熱潮中，於一個乏人問津的領域發現了價值：為這場熱潮提供資金的企業債券。
美銀首席投資策略師Michael Hartnett在最新一期「Flow Show」報告中表示，「買進科技債這些『待發掘的鑽石』，因為AI超大規模雲端服務業者正增加股權發行、減少股票買回。」
這項建議出爐之際，科技債券市場今年以來已經歷一波沉重跌勢。
為何科技債是「待發掘的鑽石」？
Hartnett指出，美國科技企業債券2026年以來已下跌約9%。
因此，科技債券相較於整體投資級債券指數的總報酬，已降至30年來最低水準。換句話說，相較於其他高評級債券，科技企業債務的價格已很少像現在這樣便宜。
主要原因在於供給增加。AI超大規模雲端服務業者為了建設資料中心而舉債，今年已發行1,820億美元債券，遠高於2024年的170億美元。
投資人要求更高的殖利率，才願意承接這波債券供給。因此，「七巨頭」及其他AI領導企業的長期債券，目前殖利率已達6%至8%，Hartnett認為這個水準具有吸引力。
資料來源：美銀全球研究
在信用評級較低的債券市場，CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 2031年到期的高收益債券，殖利率則達到14.26%。
為何債券持有人正取得更有利地位？
Hartnett論點的第二個重點，在於超大規模雲端服務業者目前的融資方式正在改變。
他表示，Meta近期的股票發行，顯示公司開始更加重視債券投資人。透過出售股票而非繼續增加債務，可以強化債券持有人所仰賴的資產負債表。
Hartnett也認為，AI債券長期以來表現落後AI股票的局面，正接近尾聲。
2026年以來，超大規模雲端服務業者已透過發行股票籌集890億美元。同時，這些公司的股票買回規模按年化速度計算僅有140億美元，遠低於2024年的1,050億美元。
Hartnett認為，這代表大規模股票買回的時代已經結束。過去回流股東手中的現金，如今留在企業內部，反而有利於持有企業債券的投資人。
這種壓力來自資本支出。美銀估計，AI資本支出將從2024年的2,400億美元攀升至2027年的1.2兆美元。同一期間，自由現金流預計將從2,400億美元轉為負1,800億美元。
因此，Hartnett表示，債券市場如今正在監督AI熱潮。
信用市場仍保持戒心
債券市場尚未解除警報。根據截至週五的標普全球市場情報數據，自9月初以來，大型科技公司的五年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差大幅擴大。這項指標反映企業每年為債務購買違約保障所需支付的成本。
甲骨文的利差從9月1日的210個基點升至276個基點；輝達從84個基點升至129個基點，Meta則從94個基點升至118個基點。
Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 從61個基點升至85個基點，亞馬遜則從67個基點升至90個基點。微軟仍是信用風險最低的企業，利差從47個基點升至55個基點。
不過，市場已出現初步穩定跡象。甲骨文的利差已從10月20日的325個基點高點回落。
標普全球也指出，市場正出現更深層的轉變。在10月13日發布的最新報告中，該機構表示，即使整體投資級債券市場維持穩定，AI曝險較高的科技企業債券利差仍持續擴大。
標普全球指出，投資人愈來愈將AI曝險視為一種獨立的信用風險。此外，超大規模雲端服務業者、晶片製造商及其他AI債券發行人的相關性愈來愈高，意味著科技債券開始以單一主題的方式交易，削弱了持有多家企業債券原本能帶來的分散風險效益。
債券供給短期內也不會減少。標普全球表示，今年前三季，與超大規模雲端服務業者相關的債券發行規模已達約2,400億美元，全年發行量可望達到其預估的2,500億至3,000億美元。
Hartnett關注的關鍵價位
Hartnett預期，在全球升息週期結束之前，市場避險情緒仍將持續。過去六個月，各國央行已合計升息42次。
他認為，2027年上半年可能出現緩解市場壓力的轉機，包括地緣政治局勢趨於和平、油價大幅下跌，以及升息週期結束。
Hartnett表示，在年底行情反彈之前，有兩個價位必須守住：Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS-US) 的70美元，以及VanEck半導體ETF (SMH-US) 的520美元。
上週五，MAGS下跌2.2%，收在69.70美元，略低於這條防線；SMH則仍比其關鍵價位高出約8%。
美國公債殖利率也未能帶來太多緩解。10年期公債殖利率為4.93%，30年期則為5.29%。iShares iBoxx美元投資級公司債ETF (LQD-US) 今年以來下跌5.5%。
Hartnett的論點建立在一項簡單的轉變上：到目前為止，AI競賽的資金主要由股東提供；如今，債券持有人則能以更高的報酬，為下一階段的發展提供融資，即使違約保障成本仍顯示信用市場保持戒心。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Bank of America’s chief strategist has identified value in a neglected area amid the AI investment frenzy: corporate bonds that fund the boom.

Bank of America chief investment strategist Michael Hartnett said in the latest “Flow Show” report, “Buy tech bonds – these ‘undiscovered diamonds’ – because the massive AI cloud providers are increasing equity issuance and cutting share buybacks."
The recommendation comes as the tech bond market has already endured a steep decline this year.
Why are tech bonds considered ‘undiscovered diamonds’?
Hartnett notes that U.S. tech corporate bonds have fallen about 9% since 2026.

Consequently, tech bonds’ total return relative to the broad investment‑grade bond index has dropped to its lowest level in three decades. In other words, compared with other high‑grade bonds, tech corporate debt is now exceptionally cheap.
The main driver is a surge in supply. The giant AI cloud providers have issued $182 billion of debt this year to build data centres, far exceeding the $17 billion issued in 2024.

Investors demand higher yields to absorb this wave of supply. As a result, long‑dated bonds of the “Big Seven” AI leaders and other AI‑driven firms now carry yields of 6‑8%, a level Hartnett finds attractive.
Source: Bank of America Global Research
In the lower‑rated segment, CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) 2031 high‑yield bonds are trading at a 14.26% yield.
Why are bondholders gaining leverage?
The second pillar of Hartnett’s argument is that the financing mix of the massive cloud providers is shifting.

He points to Meta’s recent equity offering as evidence that the company is paying more attention to bond investors. By raising cash through stock rather than adding more debt, the balance sheet supporting bondholders is strengthened.
Hartnett also believes the long‑standing outperformance of AI stocks versus AI bonds is nearing its end.

Since 202‑6, the big cloud providers have raised $89 billion via equity issuance. At the same time, their share‑buyback programmes have slowed to an annualised $14 billion, far below the $105 billion in 2024.
He says this signals the era of large‑scale buybacks is over. Cash that used to flow back to shareholders now stays inside the companies, which benefits investors holding corporate bonds.

The pressure comes from capital spending. Bank of America estimates AI capex will climb from $240 billion in 2024 to $1.2 trillion in 2027. Over the same period, free cash flow is expected to swing from $240 billion positive to a $180 billion deficit.
Thus, Hartnett says the bond market is now watching the AI boom closely.
Credit markets remain cautious

Bond markets have not lifted the warning flag. According to S&P Global Market Intelligence data through Friday, five‑year credit‑default swap spreads for large tech firms have widened sharply since early September, a metric that reflects the cost of buying default protection each year.
Oracle’s spread widened from 210 basis points on Sept 1 to 276 basis points; Nvidia’s rose from 84 to 129 basis points, and Meta’s from 94 to 118 basis points.
Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) moved from 61 to 85 basis points, Amazon from 67 to 90 basis points, while Microsoft remains the lowest‑risk issuer, with its spread climbing from 47 to 55 basis points.
However, early signs of stabilization have emerged. Oracle’s spread has retreated from a high of 325 basis points on Oct 20.

S&P Global also notes a deeper shift in the market. In its Oct 13 report, the agency said that even though the overall investment‑grade bond market is stable, spreads on tech corporate bonds with high AI exposure continue to widen.

S&P Global adds that investors are increasingly treating AI exposure as a distinct credit risk. Moreover, the correlation among AI‑heavy cloud providers, chip makers and other AI bond issuers is rising, meaning tech bonds are trading more like a single‑theme asset and the diversification benefit of holding many issuers is eroding.

Bond supply will not shrink in the short term. S&P Global says that in the first three quarters of this year, bond issuance tied to the massive cloud providers reached roughly $240 billion, and total 2024 issuance could hit $250‑$300 battle‑billion.
Key price levels Hartnett is watching
Hartnett expects that until the global rate‑hike cycle ends, market‑wide risk‑off sentiment will persist. In the past six months, central banks worldwide have raised rates a combined 42 times.
He believes the first half of 2027 could bring relief, driven by easing geopolitical tensions, a sharp drop in oil prices, and the end of the rate‑hike cycle.
Hartnett says two price points must hold before a year‑end rally: the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) at $70 and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) at $520.
Last Friday MAGS fell 2.2% to $69.70, just below that support level; SMH remains about 8% above its critical level.

U.S. Treasury yields have offered little relief. The 10‑year Treasury is at 4.93% and the 20‑year at 5.29%. The iShares iBoxx USD Investment‑Grade Corporate Bond ETF (LQD‑US) is down 5.5% year‑to‑date.

Hartnett’s thesis rests on a simple shift: so far, the AI race has been financed mainly by shareholders; now bondholders can fund the next stage at higher returns, even as default‑protection costs show the credit market remains wary.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉研華Q3獲利創高、展望正向 無懼大盤跌千點逆勢收紅
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Advantech Q3 profit hits record, outlook positive, unafraid of market falling 1,000 points, closes higher
paras: 工業電腦大廠研華(2395-TW)第三季獲利飆高，且接單動能續強，在手訂單金額持續增加，第四季展望正向，週五無懼大盤跌千點，逆勢收紅，上漲1%、收680元。
研華第三季稅後純益62.18億元，季增37.63%、年增124.79%，每股純益7.15元，續創單季新高；累計前三季稅後純益140.70億元，年增87.87%，每股純益16.21元，同創同期最佳，且已賺贏去年全年。
研華財務長暨綜合經營管理總經理陳清熙表示，第三季接單出貨比 (B/B Ratio)為 1.64，接單與出貨金額持續季增，三大區域皆較上季成長，其中北美達 2.12，歐洲及中國分別提升至 1.52 及 1.50，顯示整體接單動能保持強勁。
陳清熙指出，儘管原物料成本波動及供應鏈挑戰仍在，但已展開相應布局確保長期供料穩健並延續成本轉嫁機制，可望維持高度營運韌性。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395-TW) saw its Q3 profit soar, and order momentum remains strong, with the value of orders on hand continuing to rise. The outlook for Q4 is positive, and on Friday the stock closed higher despite the market dropping a thousand points, gaining 1% to NT$680.

Advantech's Q3 after‑tax net profit was NT$6.218 billion, up 37.63% quarter‑over‑quarter and 124.79% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$7.15, setting a new single‑quarter high. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$14.070 billion, up 87.87% YoY, with EPS of NT$16.21, also a record for the period and already exceeding last year’s full‑year profit.

Chief Financial Officer and General Manager of Integrated Operations Chen Qing‑xi said the Q3 order‑to‑shipment ratio (B/B Ratio) was 1.64, with order and shipment values continuing to grow quarter‑over‑quarter. All three major regions posted growth versus the prior quarter, with North America reaching 2.12 and Europe and China rising to 1.52 and 1.50 respectively, indicating that overall order momentum remains strong.

Chen added that although raw‑material cost fluctuations and supply‑chain challenges persist, the company has begun corresponding measures to ensure a stable long‑term supply and to continue its cost‑pass‑through mechanism, which should maintain a high level of operational resilience.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉東捷資訊搭資安題材 逆勢續漲近2成創近1年新高價
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Dongjie Information Leverages Cybersecurity Theme to Rise Nearly 20% Against the Trend, Hits One‑Year High
paras: 資訊軟體服務商東捷資訊 (6697-TW) 本周股價再度大漲，並未受大盤重挫的衝擊，走出自己的路，周漲幅高達18%，合計二周來漲幅近30%，最高來到去年11月中旬以來高點，反映資安題材火熱。
由於全球資安問題擴大，近期全球約70%網站運作的開源程式語言 PHP 被揭露存在兩項高危險性安全漏洞，資安議題再度受市場關注。
東捷資訊表示，攜手國際頂尖資安原廠建立夥伴關係，提供從事前資安盤點、檢測，到事中監控與事後支援的全方位服務，可協助企業將傳統被動防禦，升級為主動阻斷威脅的零信任顧問服務。
目前東捷資訊ERP建置案穩步推進，數據治理等智慧應用也陸續導入客戶場域並開始上線，同時優化產品組合。
東捷資訊上半年已完成鋼鐵製造大廠、電動車零組件製造大廠和 AI 技術軟體公司等多項 SAP 雲端 ERP 建置專案，並為國內知名醫療院所導入供應商交期管理系統，成功將業務拓展至醫療產業。
paras_en: Information software service provider Dongjie Information (6697‑TW) saw its stock surge again this week, shrugging off the market’s broad decline and carving its own path. The weekly gain hit 18%, bringing the two‑week rise to nearly 30% and pushing the price to its highest level since mid‑November last year, reflecting the cybersecurity theme.

As global cybersecurity concerns grow, two high‑severity vulnerabilities have been disclosed in PHP—the open‑source programming language that powers roughly 70% of websites worldwide, drawing renewed market attention to security issues.

Dongjie Information said it has partnered with leading international cybersecurity vendors to offer end‑to‑end services—from pre‑emptive security assessments and testing to real‑time monitoring and post‑incident support—helping enterprises upgrade from traditional passive defenses to proactive, zero‑trust threat‑blocking consulting services.

Its ERP implementation projects are progressing steadily, and smart applications such as data governance are being gradually rolled out at customer sites and going live, while the company continues to optimize its product portfolio.

In the first half of the year, Dongjie Information completed several SAP cloud ERP projects for major steel manufacturers, electric‑vehicle component makers and AI software firms, and also deployed a supplier delivery‑date management system for a well‑known domestic medical institution, successfully expanding its business into the healthcare sector.

items.title: 國內銀行「第一」槍！一銀粉獅幣點數可兌換USDT 攜手HOYA BIT跨幣圈
items.title_en: Domestic Bank Leads the Way! First Bank’s “Pink Lion Coin” Points Can Be Exchanged for USDT in Partnership with HOYA BIT
paras: 第一銀行積極拓展數位生態圈，攜手台灣加密貨幣交易所HOYA BIT，於粉獅幣平台推出泰達幣（USDT）兌換服務，創下國內銀行全通路點數結合穩定幣應用的首例。客戶除可兌換一般生活商品外，更能將點數轉換為數位資產，開創點數經濟新連結。一銀長期深耕區塊鏈技術，曾取得跨鏈專利並應用於供應鏈融資與外幣現鈔交易，持續秉持穩健創新理念掌握數位金融契機。
面對全球數位資產及穩定幣應用技術快速發展，第一銀行持續深化金融科技創新布局，宣布攜手台灣加密貨幣交易所HOYA BIT（禾亞數位科技），正式於粉獅幣平台推出泰達幣（USDT）兌換服務。此舉創下國內銀行首開全通路點數結合穩定幣應用的創新嘗試，不僅進一步拓展數位點數應用場景，更打造串聯傳統金融與數位資產生態的新體驗。
「粉獅幣」為第一銀行打造的點數生態平台，原本即提供客戶兌換咖啡、餐飲、生活用品、票券及數位商品等多元回饋項目。本次服務升級後，客戶可直接使用粉獅幣兌換泰達幣，讓銀行點數順利突破傳統回饋框架，創造點數經濟與數位資產應用的全新連結，為廣大客戶提供更多元且具未來性的數位金融體驗。
第一銀行長期深耕區塊鏈技術與創新金融應用，從前瞻研發到場景落地，逐步累積豐富的數位金融發展基礎。一銀過去曾取得全球首創跨鏈整合區塊鏈發明專利，並攜手企業夥伴推動區塊鏈供應鏈融資應用，透過分散式帳本技術有效提升融資流程效率與資訊透明度。同時，一銀更率先建置銀行同業外幣現鈔買賣區塊鏈平台，大幅優化銀行間外幣現鈔交易與資訊交換機制。
積極布局數位資產領域的第一銀行表示，未來將持續追蹤國際監理制度及市場趨勢，積極探索數位資產與金融服務結合的各類創新應用。一銀將透過跨產業合作持續拓展服務場景，秉持「穩健創新、安全發展」的核心理念，打造更便利、更安全且更具前瞻性的服務體驗，精準掌握數位資產及區塊鏈技術發展的重大契機。
paras_en: First Bank is actively expanding its digital ecosystem by partnering with Taiwan cryptocurrency exchange HOYA BIT to launch a USDT (Tether) redemption service on its Pink Lion Coin platform, marking the first instance in the country of a bank integrating points across all channels with a stablecoin. Customers can not only redeem points for everyday goods but also convert them into digital assets, creating a new link in the points economy. First Bank has long cultivated blockchain technology, securing a cross‑chain patent applied to supply‑chain financing and foreign‑cash transactions, and continues to pursue stable, innovative approaches to seize digital finance opportunities.

Facing the rapid global development of digital assets and stable‑coin applications, First Bank is deepening its fintech innovation strategy and announced a partnership with Taiwan crypto exchange HOYA BIT (He Ya Digital Technology) to officially roll out a USDT redemption service on the Pink Lion Coin platform. This move creates the first domestic‑bank innovation that combines points across all channels with a stablecoin, further expanding digital‑point use cases and forging a new experience that links traditional finance with the digital‑asset ecosystem.

“Pink Lion Coin” is the points‑ecosystem platform built by First Bank, originally offering customers redemption options such as coffee, dining, everyday goods, tickets and digital products. After the service upgrade, customers can directly use Pink Lion Coins to exchange for USDT, allowing bank points to break out of the traditional reward framework and creating a brand‑new connection between the points economy and digital‑asset usage, providing a more diverse and forward‑looking digital‑finance experience for a wide customer base.

First Bank has long been devoted to blockchain technology and innovative financial applications, building a solid foundation for digital finance from forward‑looking R&D to real‑world deployment. The bank previously secured the world’s first cross‑chain blockchain integration patent and collaborated with corporate partners to promote blockchain‑based supply‑chain financing, using distributed ledger technology to improve financing efficiency and information transparency. In addition, First Bank was the first to establish a blockchain platform for inter‑bank foreign‑cash buying and selling, greatly optimizing the exchange and information‑sharing mechanisms for foreign cash among banks.

With an active strategy in the digital‑asset space, First Bank says it will continue to monitor international regulatory regimes and market trends, actively exploring various innovative applications that combine digital assets with financial services. The bank will keep expanding service scenarios through cross‑industry collaborations, adhering to its core principle of “steady innovation, safe development” to deliver more convenient, secure and forward‑looking experiences, and precisely capture the major opportunities presented by digital‑asset and blockchain technology development.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗臺輝達工作站新品與獲利爆發加持 無懼大盤回檔獲外資逆勢買超
items.title_en: Hot Stock: LITEON’s New NVIDIA Workstation Products and Profit Surge Boost, Unfazed by Market Pullback, Foreign Investors Buy Against the Trend
paras: 顯卡暨人工智慧解決方案供應商麗臺(2465-TW)本週在台股大盤面臨崩跌回檔壓力之際，憑藉輝達工作站晶片拉貨暢旺與母集團美超微股價走揚帶動，獲得外資法人逆勢買超力挺。30日雖受大盤大跌拖累回檔亮燈跌停收在102元，外資當日依舊加碼買超659張，並且連續三個交易日站在買方，累計買超達2836張，周漲幅約6%，周成交量4萬張。
財務表現方面，麗臺今年前三季累計營收達73.9億元，年增109.34%。麗臺第三季單季稅後盈餘達3.79億元，較去年同期暴增11.45倍，單季每股稅後純益為4.03元，大幅改寫歷史新高紀錄。
業務動能部分，麗臺受惠經銷代理輝達GB10平台的桌上型超級電腦，以及高階工作站繪圖晶片加速卡今年以來供不應求，加上記憶體價格上漲帶動產品售價顯著調升，成為推升獲利逐季創高的重要引擎。下半年接續推出新一代AI工作站，以及即將進入量產階段的工作站繪圖卡新品，法人預估將為第四季營運增添新一波動能。
由於麗臺在中國市場的業務佔比超過六成，新一代工作站晶片符合規範並可順利銷往當地，剛好迎合中國市場對於高效能運算算力的迫切需求。
paras_en: Graphics‑card and AI solution provider LITEON (2465‑TW) this week, amid a sharp pullback in the Taiwan market, leveraged strong demand for NVIDIA workstation chips and a rally in its parent group’s AMD stock to attract net buying from foreign institutional investors. On the 30th, despite the market’s steep decline that pushed the stock to a limit‑down close at NT$102, foreign investors added 659 lots and have been net buyers for three consecutive sessions, accumulating 2,836 lots this week, a weekly gain of about 6% on a volume of 40,000 lots.

In terms of financial performance, LITEON’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of this year reached NT$7.39 billion, up 109.34% year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q3 hit NT$379 million, a 11.45‑fold increase from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$4.03, setting a new historical high.

On the business side, LITEON has benefited from the distribution of NVIDIA’s GB10 platform desktop supercomputers and high‑end workstation graphics accelerator cards, which have been in excess demand since the start of the year. Rising memory prices have also allowed product prices to be raised significantly, driving quarterly profit records. The rollout of a next‑generation AI workstation in the second half of the year and the upcoming mass production of a new workstation graphics card are expected by analysts to add a fresh boost to Q4 operations.

Because more than 60% of LITEON’s sales are in the Chinese market, the new generation workstation chips meet local regulations and can be sold there, perfectly aligning with China’s urgent demand for high‑performance computing power.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉科妍玻尿酸產品有望攻千億人民幣醫美市場 喜迎兩根漲停周漲近2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Koyan’s Hyaluronic Acid Product Poised to Tap Trillion‑RMB Medical‑Aesthetic Market, Enjoys Two Limit‑Up Days, Weekly Rise Near 20%
paras: 科妍(1786-TW)旗下最新第三代雙重交聯技術產品「法思麗輕感皮下填補劑(含利多卡因注射用交聯透明質酸鈉凝膠)」，已正式通過中國國家藥品監督管理局(NMPA)審查，取得三類醫療器材器械註冊證書，有望搶攻千億人民幣的醫美市場，激勵科妍本周喜迎2根漲停，周漲近2成。
科妍本周大漲19.77%，並於周四(29日)、周五(30日)連2日亮紅燈，周五收47.55元，一舉站回5日線、月線以及季線。三大法人連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超304張。
科妍指出，「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」含有利多卡因，用於面部鼻唇溝部位真皮組織中層至深層注射，以矯正中度或重度的鼻唇溝，並可有減舒緩注射過程中的疼痛感。
而此次取證的「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」於2023年送件，並通過審查與補件程序，突破中國合規醫美市場的高難度准入門檻，也是台灣首張於中國獲准上市的「含藥(利多卡因)透明質酸皮下植入劑」證書。
根據產業研究機構報告，2026年中國注射醫美市場針劑數量已超過千萬支，且經濟規模已達2000億人民幣以上，其中，玻尿酸皮下填補劑為主要成長動能。科妍預期，隨著「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」取得中國認證，將進一步挹注營運。
paras_en: Koyan (1786‑TW) announced that its latest third‑generation dual‑crosslinked product, Fasili Light‑Feel Subdermal Filler (containing lidocaine‑based crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel), has passed review by China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and obtained a Class‑III medical device registration certificate, positioning it to capture a market worth a trillion RMB in medical aesthetics and prompting the stock to hit two limit‑up days this week, lifting its weekly gain to nearly 20%.

The stock surged 19.77% this week and lit up red on both Thursday (the 29th) and Friday (the 30th), closing at NT$47.55 on Friday and reclaiming its 5‑day, monthly and quarterly moving averages. The three major institutional investors bought net shares for three consecutive trading days, totaling a net purchase of 304 lots for the week.

Koyan explained that Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) contains lidocaine and is intended for mid‑to‑deep dermal injections in the nasolabial fold area to correct moderate to severe folds, while also helping to alleviate pain during the injection procedure.

The certified Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) was submitted for approval in 2023, passed the review and supplemental documentation stages, overcoming the high‑threshold compliance barrier of China’s medical‑aesthetic market. It is also Taiwan’s first “drug‑containing (lidocaine) hyaluronic acid subdermal implant” to receive approval for sale in China.

According to an industry research report, China’s injectable medical‑aesthetic market will exceed ten million syringes by 2026, with an economic scale surpassing RMB 2000 billion, driven primarily by hyaluronic acid fillers. Koyan expects that the Chinese certification of Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) will further boost its operations.

items.title: 鴻海科技日登場、電子權值股法說周、景氣燈號連10紅 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day, Electronic Stocks Earnings Calls, 10-Month Red Economic Signal – Weekly Highlights
paras: 鴻海科技日周五(30日)登場，董事長劉揚偉指出，鴻海AI伺服器機架周產能已較去年翻倍，達2000架，並看好明年營運維持雙位數成長；台達電、聯電及日月光等電子權值股本周紛紛召開法說會，並釋出最新展望；國發會周四(29日)發布景氣燈號，連續10個月亮紅燈，也是疫情以來最長的紅燈周期紀錄，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈鴻海科技日〉劉揚偉：今年展現集團加乘力與垂直整合力 AI伺服器機架產能已較去年翻倍 

鴻海(2317-TW)周五(30日)舉行2026年鴻海科技日，董事長劉揚偉於開幕致詞時表示，今年邁入第七屆，也是歷年規模最大的一次，特別要向外界展示鴻海的「加乘力」及「垂直整合力」。他也透露，短短一年內，鴻海AI伺服器機架週產能已從上次科技日的1,000架翻倍至每週2,000架，展現快速擴大AI伺服器製造規模的能力。
另外，劉揚偉會後受訪時也表示，明年產業景氣仍呈現K型發展，AI資料中心相關需求持續向上，其他產業則呈現不同走勢，預期鴻海明年營運仍可維持雙位數成長。

〈台達電法說〉Q4營收估季增、毛利率不低於上季 馬國將設大型生產據點 

台達電(2308-TW)周四(29日)召開法說會，董事長鄭平表示，第四季營收一定高於第三季，毛利率則不會比第三季差，但年底仍有部分無形資產等項目需要檢視。展望明年，隨著AI資料中心建置需求持續，預期整體營運仍將維持成長趨勢，AI及資料中心相關業務將持續扮演主要成長動能。全球產能布局方面，台達電董事會已通過在馬來西亞檳城設立大型生產據點。

〈日月光法說〉Q4 營收估季增 6-8%、再度追加資本支出 LEAP目標上修明年可望翻倍 

半導體封測廠日月光投控 (3711-TW) 周四(29日)召開法說，展望第四季，日月光投控預估，在 1 美元兌 31.9 元新台幣的匯率假設下，集團合併營收將季增 6% 至 8%；另因應先進封裝需求持續強勁，宣布2026年資本支出追加 10 億美元，由原先 105 億美元上調至 115 億美元，再創歷史新高。

〈聯電法說〉追加32億美元資本支出 三年內AI營收占比衝25% 

晶圓代工廠聯電(2303-TW)周三(28日)召開線上法說會，並宣布董事會已核准追加約32億美元資本支出，加速新加坡與台南廠區擴充工程，聯電定調在矽光子與先進封裝帶動下，未來三年內AI相關營收將從目前約3億美元大幅拉升，占全公司營收比重衝上25%。

〈景氣燈號〉疫後最長擴張連10紅！分數升至41分 國發會看好3大引擎支撐燈號續紅 

國發會周四(29日)發布2026年9月景氣概況，景氣對策信號綜合判斷分數達41分，較8月下修值40分增加1分，燈號連續10個月亮出紅燈，創下疫情以來最長的紅燈周期紀錄。這波擴張主要受惠於人工智慧相關產業生產動能強勁，帶動工業及服務業加班工時轉呈黃紅燈。同時，領先與同時指標皆續呈上升，確認台灣經濟正處穩健成長軌道。經濟發展處處長陳美菊提出三大重點，看好出口、投資與消費將持續扮演拉抬經濟的關鍵引擎。

TSIA估台灣半導體今年產值達5.3兆元大增22% 力挺政府重啟核電評估 

TSIA台灣半導體協會周四(29日)舉辦30周年年會，現任理事長侯永清表示，預估2026年台灣半導體產業總產值突破5.3兆元，年增率達22%，同時正式表態在合規與安全前提下支持政府重啟核電評估，並將攜手權值龍頭台積電(2330-TW)等夥伴壯大生態系。

〈楊金龍立院備詢〉重申匯市依循「柳樹理論」可防範波動過大 

中央銀行總裁楊金龍周三(28日)赴立院財委會備詢，立委提及台股交投集中於特定產業，外資調節高科技股的水位就會造成新台幣的貶值壓力。對此，楊金龍回應，央行依循「柳樹理論」讓匯率適度擺動，不會睡不安穩，並再次強調沒有楊金龍防線。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) held its 2026 Tech Day on Friday, October 30, with Chairman Liu Yang‑wei announcing that the weekly production capacity of its AI server racks has doubled from 1,000 units at the last Tech Day to 2,000 units, and that the company expects double‑digit growth in operations next year.

Liu Yang‑wei added that the industry will continue a K‑shaped recovery next year, with AI data center demand rising while other sectors will move differently, and that Foxconn’s operations should remain in double‑digit growth.

Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) held an earnings call on Thursday, October 29, where Chairman Zheng Ping said fourth‑quarter revenue will exceed third‑quarter revenue and gross margin will not be lower than the previous quarter; some intangible assets will still need review at year‑end. The company expects continued growth driven by AI data center construction, with AI and data center businesses remaining key growth drivers. The board approved a large production site in Penang, Malaysia.

ASE (3711‑TW) held an earnings call on Thursday, October 29, projecting a 6%–8% quarter‑on‑quarter revenue increase for Q4 under a USD 1 to NT$31.9 exchange rate, and announced a $10 billion capital expenditure increase for 2026, raising the 2025 target from $10.5 billion to $11.5 billion, a new record.

UMC (2303‑TW) held an online earnings call on Wednesday, October 28, announcing board approval of an additional $3.2 billion capital expenditure to accelerate expansion at its Singapore and Tainan sites. UMC expects AI‑related revenue to rise from about $300 million to 25% of total revenue over the next three years, driven by silicon photonics and advanced packaging.

The Economic Development Council released its September 2026 economic outlook on Thursday, October 29, scoring the composite economic signal at 41 points, up one point from August’s 40, and marking the longest consecutive red‑light period of 10 months since the pandemic. The expansion is largely driven by strong AI industry momentum, pushing industrial and service sectors into yellow‑red signals, while leading and lagging indicators remain upward, confirming Taiwan’s steady growth trajectory. Director Chen Meijiu highlighted exports, investment, and consumption as key engines sustaining the economy.

The Taiwan Semiconductor Association (TSIA) celebrated its 30th anniversary on Thursday, October 29, with Chairman Hou Yong‑qing estimating Taiwan’s semiconductor industry output will exceed NT$5.3 trillion in 2026, a 22% annual increase, and formally supporting the government’s restart of nuclear power assessment under compliance and safety conditions, partnering with industry leaders like TSMC (2330‑TW) to strengthen the ecosystem.

Yang Jin‑long, Governor of the Central Bank, appeared before the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee on Wednesday, October 28, where lawmakers noted that concentrated trading in certain industries and foreign‑investor adjustments to high‑tech stocks could pressure the New Taiwan Dollar. Yang responded that the central bank follows the “willow‑tree theory” to allow moderate currency swings, emphasizing that there is no “Yang Jin‑long defense line.”

The Economic Development Council’s 10‑month red‑light record reflects the strongest AI‑driven expansion since the pandemic, with exports, investment, and consumption poised to keep the economy on a robust growth path.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉欣興旗下同泰電子結束連19季虧損Q3轉盈 周漲24%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Xin Xing’s subsidiary Tong Tai Electronics ends 19‑quarter loss, Q3 turns profit, weekly rise 24%
paras: 欣興(3037-TW)旗下軟板廠同泰電子(3321-TW)公布最新財報獲利成績單，結束連19季虧損，第三季營收放大並轉盈，單季稅後純益4432萬元，每股純益0.51元，在轉機色彩濃厚之下，同泰股價收在20.1元，周漲24.46%。
同泰電子2026年第三季營收6.93億元，毛利率18.77%，季增5.95個百分點，年增8.83個百分點，單季稅後純益4432萬元，較上一季及去年同期都由虧轉盈，每股純益0.51元，但累計1-3季仍虧損2321萬元，每股虧損0.27元。
同泰電子股價本周爆量走揚，30日收在20.1元，單周大漲24.46%，股價已站穩所有均線，並完成三重底型態，短線技術面轉強。目前5日線18.99元為短線支撐，10日線與月線則在17.8元附近糾結，形成另一道支撐區。
paras_en: Xin Xing (3037‑TW) subsidiary soft‑board manufacturer Tong Tai Electronics (3321‑TW) released its latest financial results, ending a streak of 19 consecutive quarters of losses. In Q3 revenue expanded and the company turned to profit, posting a quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$44.32 million, or NT$0.51 per share. Amid the strong turnaround, Tong Tai’s stock closed at NT$20.10, up 24.46% for the week.

Tong Tai Electronics reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$693 million, a gross margin of 18.77%, up 5.95 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 8.83 points year‑over‑year. The quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$44.32 million, or NT$0.51 per share, marked a swing from loss to profit compared with both the prior quarter and the same period last year. However, cumulative results for the first three quarters still show a loss of NT$23.21 million, or a loss of NT$0.27 per share.

Tong Tai’s stock surged with heavy volume this week, closing at NT$20.10 on the 30th, a weekly gain of 24.46%. The price has now stabilized above all moving averages and completed a triple‑bottom pattern, indicating a short‑term technical strengthening. The 5‑day moving average at NT$18.99 serves as immediate support, while the 10‑day and monthly averages are tangled around NT$17.80, forming another support zone.

paras_en: According to FactSet’s latest survey, seven analysts provided target price estimates for Jingshuo (6491‑TW). The median target was revised upward from 425 TWD to 455 TWD, a 7.06% increase. The highest estimate is 525 TWD and the lowest is 360 TWD.
Composite rating – a total of seven analysts rated Jingshuo (6491‑TW): five were bullish, two were neutral, and none were bearish.

Jingshuo (6491‑TW) closed at 419 TWD today (the 30th). Over the past five days the stock fell 0.95%, the related biotech‑health sector fell 0.86%, and the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 1.8%, indicating the stock’s movement was in line with the broader market.
Source: FactSet. Data are for reference only and do not constitute investment advice.

items.title: Alphabet黑色10月！單月市值蒸發7580億美元、創上市以來最慘表現 本益比降至十年新低
items.title_en: Alphabet's Black October! Market Cap Evaporates $758 B in a Month, Worst Performance Since IPO, P/E Hits 10‑Year Low
paras: 大型科技股經歷慘烈一周，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)成為這波跌勢的核心。根據《Yahoo Finance》計算，Alphabet本周市值蒸發4680億美元，超過SpaceX(SPCX-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)市值減少的總和。
這是Google母公司史上最慘的一周，也是美國上市公司史上第二大單周市值損失。只有輝達的單周市值蒸發幅度更大：2025年1月27日那周，中國DeepSeek震撼AI投資人，輝達市值一周減少約5520億美元。Alphabet先前最慘的一周發生在6月26日為止一周，市值減少約3860億美元。
Alphabet周四公布第3季財報後，當天市值蒸發4750億美元，是這波跌勢的主要來源。周五(30日)股價再度下滑，抹去本周稍早累積的漲幅。

10月市值蒸發7580億美元 單月跌幅近19%

周五收盤後，Alphabet的10月表現正式寫下紀錄：無論以市值損失金額或股價跌幅計算，都是該公司上市以來最慘烈的一個月。
Alphabet本月市值減少約7580億美元，是美國上市公司史上第二大單月市值損失，僅次於SpaceX今年7月市值蒸發約8220億美元的紀錄。
Alphabet本月市值損失幾乎是先前最慘月份的兩倍。該公司先前最慘的月份是2025年2月，當時市值減少約4200億美元。
若以百分比計算，Alphabet股價10月下跌近19%。先前最慘的是2008年11月，當時股價下跌18.5%。本周股價則下跌近13%，創2011年8月以來最大單周跌幅。
這波賣壓也使Alphabet本益比降至逾10年來最低水準。

不只Alphabet遭血洗 英特爾單日重挫近30%

SpaceX、英特爾(INTC-US)與輝達本周市值也各自減少逾1000億美元。
英特爾因財測疲弱，周五股價一度下跌30%，創數十年來最大跌幅。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周四公布財報後，本周市值減少約800億美元。
部分軟體股以百分比計算的跌幅更為慘重，ServiceNow(NOW-US)與Fortinet(FTNT-US)股價約下跌25%至34%。

瑞銀不建議退場 籲投資人分散科技股曝險

不過，市場蒸發的市值並非全數流出股市。禮來(LLY-US)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SK海力士(SKHY-US)本周市值合計增加逾3000億美元，即使「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent 7)整體表現疲弱，仍有部分企業逆勢成長。
瑞銀(UBS)投資長辦公室主張，投資人不應因市場波動而急著退場。
瑞銀美洲區投資長暨全球股票主管Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi周五寫道：「在我們看來，進一步的波動並不代表撤出市場就能有效保護投資組合，避免潛在的下跌風險。我們仍認為整體股市有上漲空間，並相信投資人應聚焦打造具韌性的投資組合，納入科技股以外的投資部位。」
paras_en: Large tech stocks endured a brutal week, with Alphabet (GOOGL-US) at the core of the decline. Yahoo Finance calculates that Alphabet’s market value shrank by $468 billion this week, exceeding the combined loss of SpaceX (SPCX-US), Intel (INTC-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US).

It was the worst week ever for Google’s parent company and the second‑largest single‑week market‑cap loss in U.S. listed‑company history. Only Nvidia’s weekly loss was larger: in the week of Jan. 27, 2025, Nvidia’s market cap fell about $552 billion after DeepSeek’s AI shock in China. Alphabet’s previous worst week was the week ending June 26, when its market cap dropped about $386 billion.

Alphabet released its Q3 earnings on Thursday, and that day its market cap evaporated $4.75 billion, fueling the sell‑off. On Friday (the 30th) the stock fell again, erasing the modest gains it had accumulated earlier in the week.

October market‑cap loss of $758 billion, nearly 19% drop for the month. After Friday’s close, Alphabet’s October performance officially set a record: by both market‑cap loss and share‑price decline, it was the company’s worst month since going public.
Alphabet’s market cap fell about $758 billion this month, the second‑largest single‑month loss among U.S. listed firms, trailing only SpaceX’s July loss of roughly $822 billion this year.
The monthly loss is almost twice the size of Alphabet’s previous worst month. That prior low was February 2025, when the market cap shrank about $420 billion.

In percentage terms, Alphabet’s stock fell nearly 19% in October. The worst month on record was November 2008, when the price dropped 18.5%. This week the stock fell about 13%, the biggest one‑week decline since August 2011.
The selling pressure also pushed Alphabet’s price‑to‑earnings ratio down to its lowest level in more than a decade.
Alphabet wasn’t the only victim; Intel saw a single‑day plunge of almost 30%.
SpaceX, Intel (INTC-US) and Nvidia each shed over $100 billion in market value this week.
Intel’s weak guidance sent its share price down 30% on Friday, the biggest drop in decades. Amazon (AMZN-US) posted earnings on Thursday, and its market cap fell about $80 billion this week.
Some software stocks suffered even steeper percentage declines, with ServiceNow (NOW-US) and Fortinet (FTNT-US) sliding roughly 25% to 34%.

However, not all market‑cap loss left the market. Lilly (LLY-US), Tesla (TSLA-US) and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) together added over $300 billion in market value this week, showing that even as the “Magnificent 7” lagged, some companies grew against the tide.
UBS’s investment‑strategy office argues investors should not rush to exit because of market turbulence.

items.title: 砸錢拚AI不再加分？雲端大廠股價劇烈分化 市場獎勵克制、懲罰開支
items.title_en: Spending on AI No Longer a Bonus? Cloud Giants' Stocks Diverge Sharply as Market Rewards Restraint and Punishes Expenditure
paras: AI雲端大廠股價劇烈分化，市場正在獎勵克制、懲罰開支？甲骨文(ORCL-US) 10月28日收盤大漲10.73%，谷歌母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 隔日盤前卻重挫逾10%，微軟(MSFT-US) 則上漲逾4%。鮮明反差顯示，投資人不再一味追捧龐大AI投資，而是更在意支出何時見頂、現金流何時改善，以及企業還得向外籌措多少資金。
谷歌現金流惡化 微軟支出低於預期
谷歌第三財季營收與獲利均不如預期，自由現金流更連續兩季為負，顯示巨額AI投資尚未帶來足夠回報，難以證明支出的合理性。
微軟的情況則相對穩健。第一財季資本支出年增30%至452億美元，低於分析師預期；自由現金流雖年減27%，仍達186.3億美元。財報公布後，微軟10月29日盤前上漲逾4%。
兩者對比反映，市場關注的已不只是AI投入規模，也包括企業能否在擴張之際維持現金流。
甲骨文畫出時間表 股價大漲逾一成
甲骨文重新獲得市場青睞，關鍵在於提出資本支出見頂與現金流轉正的時間表。公司預估，資本支出將在2027至2028財年見頂，2029財年開始下降。
財務長Hilary Maxson表示，自由現金流預計自2028財年下半年轉正，2029財年將超過300億美元。甲骨文並預期，自2029財年起，不再需要依賴外部融資支撐成長，同期淨債務與年度核心獲利比率將降至3.5倍以下。
這番說法為高額AI投資畫出較明確的時間界線。甲骨文10月28日盤中一度上漲逾13%，收盤漲幅達10.73%。
融資壓力仍在 承諾有待兌現
不過，甲骨文的資金壓力尚未解除。相較微軟、亞馬遜與谷歌，其營收基礎較薄弱，且高度依賴單一客戶OpenAI。雙方合作帶來數千億美元的雲端待履行合約，也迫使甲骨文透過舉債與發股，籌資興建資料中心。
截至8月31日，甲骨文應付票據與其他借款合計1,253.4億美元，現金及約當現金約363.7億美元。公司在2027財年剩餘期間仍需額外籌資最多200億美元，債務與股權融資各占一半，並稱這將是完成本輪投資週期所需的最後一筆融資。
在現金流轉正前，甲骨文將透過供應商融資、客戶提供硬體或支付預付款，降低前期現金需求。
Emarketer分析師Jacob Bourne指出，甲骨文試圖證明，大規模AI投資有明確規劃。這些預測雖積極，卻不保證能實現，但至少顯示公司理解投資人的疑慮，並提出解決路徑。
AI投資回報面臨更嚴格檢驗
三家大廠的市場反應顯示，投資人正更嚴格檢視資本支出與現金流。甲骨文獲得肯定的，是提出支出降溫與減少融資依賴的路徑；谷歌則因業績不如預期、現金流惡化而承壓。
高盛首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius本週也警告，超大規模資料中心的AI投資成長預計將在未來幾週見頂。經過多年密集投入，AI投資能否轉化為現金回報，正成為市場評價雲端大廠的重要依據。
paras_en: AI cloud giants' stock prices are diverging sharply, with the market rewarding restraint and penalizing spending. Oracle (ORCL-US) surged 10.73% on October 28, Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, plunged more than 10% in pre‑market trading the next day, and Microsoft (MSFT-US) rose over 4%. The stark contrast shows investors are no longer blindly cheering massive AI spending; they care more about when expenditures will peak, when cash flow will improve, and how much external financing companies will still need.
Google's cash flow deteriorates while Microsoft’s spending comes in below expectations

Google’s third‑quarter revenue and profit both missed expectations, and free cash flow was negative for a second consecutive quarter, indicating that huge AI investments have not yet generated sufficient returns and cannot justify the outlays.

Microsoft’s situation is relatively solid. Capital expenditures in the first quarter rose 30% year‑over‑year to $45.2 billion, below analysts’ forecasts; free cash flow fell 27% year‑over‑year but still amounted to $18.63 billion. After the earnings release, Microsoft rose more than 4% in pre‑market trading on October 29.
The contrast between the two reflects that the market is now focused not only on the scale of AI investment but also on whether companies can maintain cash flow while expanding.
Oracle charts a timeline, stock jumps more than 10%

Oracle has regained market favor by laying out a timeline for capital‑expenditure peaks and a return to positive cash flow. The company projects that capex will peak in fiscal 2027‑2028 and start to decline in fiscal 2029.

Chief Financial Officer Hilary Maxson said free cash flow is expected to turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and exceed $30 billion in fiscal 2029. Oracle also expects that from fiscal 2029 onward it will no longer need external financing to support growth, and its net‑debt‑to‑core‑earnings ratio will fall below 3.5×.
This guidance draws a clearer time horizon for Oracle’s large AI investments. Oracle’s stock rose more than 13% intraday on October 28 and closed up 10.73%.
Financing pressure remains, promises yet to be fulfilled

However, Oracle’s financing pressure has not been eliminated. Compared with Microsoft, Amazon and Google, its revenue base is weaker and it is heavily dependent on a single customer, OpenAI. The partnership brings cloud contracts worth hundreds of billions of dollars that still need to be fulfilled, forcing Oracle to raise debt and issue equity to fund data‑center construction.

As of August 31, Oracle’s notes and other borrowings totaled $125.34 billion, while cash and cash equivalents were about $36.37 billion. The company says it will need up to an additional $20 billion of financing during the remainder of fiscal 2027, split evenly between debt and equity, and that this will be the final round of financing needed to complete the current investment cycle.
Before cash flow turns positive, Oracle will rely on supplier financing, hardware provided by customers, or advance payments to reduce early cash needs.

eMarketer analyst Jacob Bourne noted that Oracle is trying to prove that large‑scale AI investment can be done with a clear plan. While the forecasts are optimistic and not guaranteed to materialize, they at least show the company understands investors’ concerns and is offering a path forward.
AI investment returns face stricter scrutiny

The market reactions to the three giants show investors are scrutinizing capital spending and cash flow more rigorously. Oracle earned praise for outlining a path to cool spending and reduce financing reliance; Google is under pressure due to weaker results and deteriorating cash flow.

Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius warned this week that the growth of ultra‑large data‑center AI investments is expected to peak in the coming weeks. After years of intensive spending, whether AI investment can be turned into cash returns is becoming a key metric for evaluating cloud providers.

items.title: Google跨足川普「金穹」計畫？傳洽談資料安全合作 搶攻1850億美元商機
items.title_en: Google Moves Into Trump’s “Golden Dome” Project? Reports of Data‑Security Talks Target $185 B Opportunity
paras: 知情人士透露，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google正與美國國防部洽談，準備參與一項新的資安計畫，為規模1850億美元「金穹」(Golden Dome)的飛彈防禦計畫提供支援，是這家科技巨頭首度傳出參與美國總統川普主打的國防計畫。
知情人士表示，五角大廈正在籌組專門的產業聯盟，負責保護輸送至計畫核心軍事指揮與控制軟體的資料管道。雙方討論重點包括採用Google的資料儲存、網路連接及網路安全基礎設施，確保即使對手破壞傳統地面網路或行動通訊基地台，通訊仍能維持運作。

Google旗下Aalyria也可能參與

儘管相關討論仍處於初步階段，未來安排也可能變動，但預料將有多家商業合作夥伴參與這項計畫，包括Google分拆成立的網路技術公司Aalyria Technologies。
「金穹」是川普主打的國防計畫，目標是建立從地面延伸至太空的多層防禦系統，以保護美國免受外國攻擊。
金穹計畫的指揮與控制系統由另一個獨立聯盟負責開發，成員包括Anduril、Palantir(PLTR-US)及SpaceX(SPCX-US)。該系統旨在整合並控制美軍各地的武器系統、雷達及其他過去彼此獨立運作的軍事系統。
若洽談最終促成合作，將是Google首度傳出參與金穹計畫，也再次凸顯這家搜尋引擎巨頭正持續擴大在國安與國防領域的布局。

Google曾因軍事AI引發內部反彈 如今加深國防合作

這項計畫凸顯五角大廈正刻意轉向多家業者組成的產業聯盟，不再單靠一家傳統主要承包商管理龐大的國防系統架構。
同時，這也反映Google在多年來因國防業務引發內部摩擦後，正加速拓展國家安全相關合約。
Google參與國防業務的歷史並不平順。2018年，數千名Google員工曾抗議公司參與名為「Maven計畫」的軍事AI專案，理由是擔憂商業技術被用於戰爭，Google最終沒有續約。
然而在那之後，Alphabet有系統地擴大公共部門業務布局，成立專責政府業務的部門，並與軍方簽署提供AI及雲端運算能力的合約。
最近一次重要進展發生在今年4月，Alphabet取得一項協議，將把自家專有AI模型部署於機密國防作業，進一步深化與美國國防部的合作。
paras_en: A source familiar with the matter says Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Google is in talks with the U.S. Department of Defense to take part in a new cyber‑security effort supporting the $185 billion “Golden Dome” missile‑defense program, marking the first time the tech giant has been linked to a defense initiative championed by President Trump.

The source adds that the Pentagon is forming a dedicated industry alliance to safeguard the data pipelines that feed the program’s core command‑and‑control software. Discussions focus on using Google’s data storage, networking and cyber‑security infrastructure to keep communications alive even if adversaries disrupt traditional ground networks or mobile‑base stations.

Google’s spin‑off Aalyria Technologies may also join. Although talks are still in early stages and plans could change, several commercial partners are expected to take part, including Aalyria, a network‑technology company spun out of Google.
The “Golden Dome” is a Trump‑promoted defense initiative aimed at building a multi‑layered shield that extends from the ground into space to protect the United States from foreign attacks.

The command‑and‑control system for the Golden Dome is being developed by a separate independent consortium that includes Anduril, Palantir (PLTR‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US). The system is intended to integrate and control U.S. military weapons, radars and other previously siloed systems worldwide.

If the talks lead to a deal, it would be the first report of Google joining the Golden Dome project and underscores how the search‑engine giant is expanding its footprint in national security and defense.

The project highlights the Pentagon’s deliberate shift toward industry alliances composed of multiple firms rather than relying on a single traditional prime contractor to manage massive defense system architectures.
It also reflects Google’s accelerating push into national‑security contracts after years of internal friction over its defense work.

Google’s defense‑sector history has been rocky. In 2018, thousands of employees protested the company’s involvement in the “Maven” military AI project, fearing commercial technology would be used for warfare, and Google ultimately let the contract lapse.

Since then, Alphabet has systematically broadened its public‑sector business, creating a dedicated government‑sales unit and signing contracts to provide AI and cloud‑computing capabilities to the military.

The most recent major development came in April this year, when Alphabet secured an agreement to deploy its proprietary AI models for classified defense operations, deepening its collaboration with the U.S. Department of Defense.

items.title: 黑石：Anthropic在IPO後或只能獲得「垃圾」評級！融資成本恐攀升
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 的融資前景面臨新挑戰。全球私募股權巨頭黑石(BX-US) 已向投資人示警，Anthropic 上市後可能無法立即取得投資級信用評級，主要評級機構更可能將其評為較高級的「垃圾級」。
根據《金融時報》報導，黑石是在向 Anthropic 最新一筆630億美元晶片融資案的投資人傳達上述看法。
若 Anthropic 最終未能取得投資級評級，未來為規模超過8,000億美元的算力基礎設施計畫籌資，恐將面臨更大難度。
相關消息也加劇市場對 AI 產業投資熱潮的疑慮。週五（30日）美國科技股在報導曝光後進一步走低，那斯達克100指數終場下跌3.5%。
此前，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 公布財報，已使市場更加擔憂 AI 熱潮能否持續。

Anthropic投資級評級預期生變 融資成本恐攀升

知情人士表示，過去幾個月，黑石一直向投資夥伴表示，預期 Anthropic 能在今年底前取得投資級評級。
不過，根據主要信用評級機構提供的指引，黑石近期已調整看法，認為 Anthropic 更可能獲得 BB 級或以上。
依標普及惠譽的評等體系，BBB-以上為投資等級，BB+以下為投機級，市場俗稱「垃圾級」。 BB區間（BB+、BB、BB-）是垃圾級中最高的一檔，緊鄰投資等級門檻，也是「較高檔」垃圾等級的意義。
這項評級結果對 Anthropic 尤為重要。公司已於週一遞交上市申請，最快可能在下月完成有史以來規模最大的首次公開發行（IPO）。招股文件揭露，Anthropic 計畫從現在起至2045年，在算力基礎設施投入超過8,000億美元。
目前 Anthropic 持有超過1,120億美元現金及約當現金，市場預期 IPO 還可能為公司帶來約1,000億美元資金。
取得投資級評級，將有助 Anthropic 以較低利率借款，支應龐大的基礎設施投資。相較之下，許多保險公司與退休基金受到投資規範限制，主要只能配置投資級債券，或對垃圾級債務設有持有上限。
一旦 Anthropic 的信用評級落在 BB+或以下，可取得的機構資金來源將明顯縮減，借貸成本也可能隨之上升。
一名專注美國科技股的基金經理指出，能否取得信貸對 Anthropic 至關重要，若公司無法取得投資級評級，融資成本將會提高，對所有相關方都不是好消息。
Anthropic 與競爭對手 OpenAI 的銀行團隊，目前都正積極遊說主要信用評級機構，希望兩家公司上市後能取得投資級評級。
不過，對企業融資成本影響最大的三大評級機構惠譽、穆迪（Moody's）與標普，至今尚未正式給予 Anthropic 信用評級。

630億美元「北極星計畫」 仰賴博通信用背書

Anthropic 最新一筆630億美元融資交易代號為「北極星計畫」（Project North Star），華爾街銀行已於本週稍早完成交割，資金將用於支應 Anthropic 向Google(GOOGL-US) 租用1.5GW晶片的相關支出。
黑石在這筆交易中擔任主要投資人，並與參與融資的銀行合作，將債務轉售給其他投資者。
這筆交易的架構也凸顯 Anthropic 對供應商信用支持的依賴。其中，超過420億美元的優先級貸款由博通(AVGO-US) 提供擔保。
博通參與這批晶片的共同開發，並擁有 A 級高位的投資級信用評級，成為 Anthropic 得以取得這筆融資的重要條件。
優先級債務受到機構投資人青睞，主要原因在於一旦發生違約，優先級貸款的受償順位高於次級債務。
另外180億美元的次級債務，則以 Anthropic 的租賃付款作為償債支撐，因此貸款人承擔的 Anthropic 信用風險更為直接。
《金融時報》此前報導，黑石旗下基金以超過10%的高收益率，認購其中90億美元次級債務。
這部分次級債務獲得 Kroll Bond Rating Agency（KBRA）評定為 BB+，展望為正面，相較四個月前類似的「大天空計畫」（Big Sky），當時獲得的展望為穩定，評級展望已有改善。晨星 DBRS（Morningstar DBRS）則給予 BB 評級。
對於相關報導，Anthropic、黑石、KBRA、晨星 DBRS 與標普均拒絕置評，惠譽與穆迪則未回覆置評請求。

items.title: 木頭姐最新交易曝！大砍禮來2421萬美元  加碼Tempus AI、Coinbase
items.title_en: Cathie Wood’s Latest Trades: Cuts Eli Lilly by $24.212 M, Adds Tempus AI and Coinbase
paras: 方舟投資（ARK Invest）創辦人「木頭姐」、伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下 ETF 公布週五（30 日）的每日交易紀錄，顯示當天投資組合涵蓋多項買進與賣出操作。其中，最受矚目的交易是透過ARK 創新 ETF(ARKK-US) 賣出17,626股禮來(LLY-US) ，交易金額達2,421萬2,836美元。此次減碼延續方舟投資近期降低禮來持股的趨勢，此前該公司也曾賣出生技產業相關持股。
根據《Investing.com》報導，買進方面，方舟投資透過 ARKK 與ARK 生物基因科技創新 ETF(ARKG-US) 合計買進154,521股 Tempus AI(TEM-US) ，交易金額達1,202萬7,914美元。
方舟投資本週稍早才賣出 Tempus AI 持股，此次重新買進，顯示其持續關注由人工智慧（AI）驅動的醫療保健產業。

醫療保健領域方面，方舟投資買進加州太平洋生技科技(PACB-US) 480,274股，交易金額為139萬2,794美元。這項投資符合方舟投資對基因體學及生技創新領域的布局方向。
此外，繼本週早些時候的大規模買入後，方舟投資也透過 ARKF ETF 買進13,757股Robinhood(HOOD-US) ，交易金額為126萬3美元。
